findings.title: Pointwise grid removal is source-confirmed
findings.claim: v1.0.15 removes the work-grid constructor parameters and replaces the low-pass helper with pointwise causal memory.
findings.consequence: This satisfies the user's grid-removal architecture direction at source level.
findings.required_action: Preserve pointwise evaluation while repairing its trajectory-state contract.

findings.title: Voltage sorting destroys supplied trajectory order
findings.claim: dqdv sorts V_n by voltage and reconstructs the result, so the memory state depends on the set of voltages rather than the supplied chronological trajectory.
findings.consequence: Repeated, reversal, pulse, and nonmonotone protocols cannot carry their actual history.
findings.required_action: Accept an explicit monotone segment/time order and evolve a persistent state without sorting away protocol history.

findings.title: Finite-window initial state is forced to equilibrium
findings.claim: The first lagged occupancy is set equal to the first equilibrium occupancy.
findings.consequence: Prehistory and preparation state are erased at every call.
findings.required_action: Expose initial internal state or prehistory and test finite-window sensitivity.

findings.title: Direct L_V override has no zero-current limit
findings.claim: A transition-level L_V override is returned before the I <= 0 equilibrium condition.
findings.consequence: A fitted nonzero lag can survive when current is zero, contradicting the equilibrium limit.
findings.required_action: Interpret direct input as a rate coefficient/state timescale or force L_V(I=0)=0.

findings.title: Local voltage-dependent barrier is frozen at one cutoff affinity
findings.claim: The affinity A is computed once from z_cut, n, R, and T and is constant across the voltage trace.
findings.consequence: The realized barrier and lag do not respond locally to electrode potential as required by the originating experiment.
findings.required_action: Derive and evaluate a local electrochemical driving-force/barrier relation at each state.

findings.title: C-rate and Q_cell unit contract is ambiguous
findings.claim: curve computes I = c_rate * Q_cell while Q_cell is also accepted as generic charge.
findings.consequence: If Q_cell is coulombs rather than ampere-hours, current is wrong by a factor of 3600.
findings.required_action: Use distinct Q_cell_Ah and Q_cell_C inputs or an explicit unit conversion.

findings.title: Default thermal width and default dwdT disagree
findings.claim: _n_factor returns default n=1 when neither n nor w exists, but _dwdT returns zero whenever n is absent.
findings.consequence: The same transition is thermal in dQ/dV and temperature-frozen in reversible heat.
findings.required_action: Make the fallback role explicit and use a single width object for w and its derivative.

findings.title: Lag kinetics collapses local T(V) to one mean temperature
findings.claim: The array temperature is averaged to T_rep and the lag length is resolved once per transition.
findings.consequence: Nonisothermal local barrier and relaxation dependence are lost even though peak width remains pointwise in T.
findings.required_action: Evaluate the state rate locally in time/charge with T(t) rather than one trace-mean lag length.

findings.title: Einstein reference temperature is finite but not positive
findings.claim: theta_E is checked positive, but theta_E_Tref is checked only for finiteness.
findings.consequence: Zero or negative reference temperature can enter exponential/logarithmic thermodynamic formulas.
findings.required_action: Validate theta_E_Tref with the positive-temperature guard.

findings.title: LCO electronic entropy is frozen at 298.15 K
findings.claim: The LCO subclass evaluates the electronic entropy only at a hard-coded reference temperature.
findings.consequence: The claimed Sommerfeld temperature scale, implicit composition feedback, and T-squared center shift are absent.
findings.required_action: Implement the reaction-specific electronic free energy with explicit x(V,T) coupling and derivatives.

findings.title: High-voltage doped LCO scope is absent from defaults
findings.claim: The LCO dataset has only three generic transitions ending near 4.05 V and no dopant/state descriptors.
findings.consequence: It cannot represent the requested doped high-voltage LCO materials or their degradation/phase constraints.
findings.required_action: Build literature/data-backed material-specific LCO parameter/state models through the target voltage window.

findings.title: v1.0.16 through v1.0.18.1 is one code blob
findings.claim: The frozen queue maps three version paths to one Git blob.
findings.consequence: v1.0.17 and v1.0.18.1 cannot constitute independent production-code progress.
findings.required_action: Count them as documentation lineage only.

findings.title: Einstein capability is inactive in shipped defaults
findings.claim: The v1.0.18.2 helpers require theta_E, but neither shipped graphite nor LCO transition dictionaries provide it.
findings.consequence: Regression preservation is expected because the new path is dormant; it does not validate material vibrational physics.
findings.required_action: Define reaction-specific phonon quantities and validate them on multi-temperature data before activation.
